list.title: Entities
list.intro: Each entity has its own address, branding and configuration.
list.caption: List of entities
list.emptyDelegated: No entity is attached to your account. Contact a super administrator.

name.label: Entity name
name.hint: Shown on the public pages and in the emails. At most 100 characters.

fqdn.label: Address (FQDN)
fqdn.hint: Fully qualified domain name of the public pages of the entity, for example transfer.entity-a.example.com. It must point to the reverse proxy.
fqdn.taken: This address is already used by another entity.
fqdn.reserved: This address is reserved for the administration and cannot be given to an entity.

defaultLanguage.label: Default language
defaultLanguage.hint: Used when the browser language is not available, and for the emails.

storageQuota.label: Storage quota
storageQuota.hint: Total space the transfers of the entity may use. New deposits are blocked when it is reached.

maxTransfer.label: Maximum size per transfer
maxTransfer.hint: Total of the files of a transfer. At most 20 GB.
maxTransfer.hintCeiling: Total of the files of a transfer. At most {ceiling}, the ceiling set by the super administrator.
maxTransfer.aboveCeiling: The size cannot exceed the ceiling of {ceiling}.
maxTransfer.followsCeiling: Total of the files of a transfer. It will be lowered to the new ceiling of {ceiling} when you save.

maxTransferCeiling.label: Ceiling of the size per transfer
maxTransferCeiling.hint: Largest value the delegated administrators may choose for the size per transfer. Lowering it below the current size lowers that size too.

create.title: Create an entity
create.intro: The other settings (branding, network, mail, templates) are configured once the entity is created.

general.title: General
general.delegatedNote: A delegated administrator can only change the default language and the maximum size per transfer. The other settings are managed by the super administrator.
general.saved: The general settings have been saved.
general.deletingBanner: This entity is being deleted. The deletion resumes automatically if it was interrupted.

delete.title: Delete the entity
delete.text: Deletion permanently erases every transfer, file, verified address, invitation, API token and setting of the entity. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmText: Every transfer and all the data of the entity will be permanently erased. Files already backed up will become unreadable.
delete.resumes: The deletion could not be completed. It will resume automatically: until then, the entity stays marked as “deletion in progress”.

branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: Logo, colors and background image of the public pages of the entity.

colors.title: Colors
colors.invalid: Enter a color in the #RRGGBB format.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.intro: The contrast ratio must reach at least 4.5:1 (level AA) for the texts to stay readable (RGAA).
contrast.warning: At least one color does not offer sufficient contrast. The texts may be hard to read. You can still save.
contrast.serverNote: The server check, shown after saving, is authoritative.

preview.label: Preview of the public page
preview.heading: Send files
preview.text: Drop your files and share them securely.

image.deleteConfirmText: The image will be removed from the public pages of the entity.
image.types: Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Maximum size: {size}.
image.badType: This format is not accepted. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
image.tooLarge: The image exceeds the maximum size of {size}.
image.tooLargeServer: The image file or its dimensions are too large.
image.unsupportedServer: The server did not recognize this file as a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: Shown at the top of the public pages.

background.title: Background image
background.hint: Shown full screen behind the deposit area. Without an image, the default image is used.

network.title: Network
network.intro: A user is internal when their IP address belongs to a range below and their email address belongs to a domain below. Only internal users can deposit freely and send invitations.

cidrs.label: Internal IP address ranges
cidrs.hint: One range per line, in CIDR notation, for example 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32.

domains.label: Internal email domains
domains.hint: One domain per line, for example entity-a.example.com.

cidr.syntax: Not a valid IP address or CIDR range (for example 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32).
cidr.zone: IPv6 zone identifiers (%…) are not allowed.
cidr.prefixRange: The prefix length is too large: at most /32 for IPv4 and /128 for IPv6.
cidr.hostBits: The address has host bits set: enter the network address of the range.
cidr.hostBitsSuggestion: The address has host bits set: the matching range is {network}.

domain.syntax: Not a valid domain name: enter the domain alone, without spaces, @, :, / or brackets.
domain.ipLiteral: An IP address is not a mail domain.
domain.idn: This international domain name cannot be converted to its ASCII (punycode) form.
domain.tooLong: The domain name is longer than 253 characters.
domain.singleLabel: The domain must contain at least one dot, for example example.com.
domain.label: Each part of the domain may contain only letters, digits and inner hyphens, 63 characters at most.
domain.tld: The last part of the domain (top-level domain) must have at least two letters.

warnings.emptyCidrs: No IP range: nobody will be considered internal, and only invitations will allow deposits.
warnings.emptyDomains: No domain: nobody will be considered internal, and only invitations will allow deposits.
warnings.catchAll: The range {range} covers every IP address: any user of an internal domain will be able to deposit from anywhere.

network.saved: The network settings have been saved.
network.normalized: The server normalized some values. The lists shown are the saved ones.

smtp.title: Mail (SMTP)
smtp.intro: Server through which the entity sends its emails (verification codes, notifications, invitations, alerts).
smtp.notConfigured: Mail is not configured yet: the entity cannot send any email.

host.label: SMTP server
host.hint: Host name or IP address, for example smtp.example.com or smtp-relay.

security.label: Connection security
security.noneHint: No encryption: only for a relay reachable through the internal Docker network alone.

username.label: Username
username.hint: Leave empty for a relay without authentication.
username.requiredWithPassword: Enter the username that goes with the password.
username.needsSecurity: Authentication requires STARTTLS or TLS: choose one of them, or remove the username.

password.label: Password
password.reenter: The server, port or username has changed: enter the password again, or remove it.
password.encrypted: The password is encrypted in the database and never shown again.

fromAddress.label: Sender address
fromAddress.hint: Address used in the “From” field of the emails, for example transfer@entity-a.example.com.

fromName.label: Sender name
fromName.hint: Optional. Defaults to the name of the entity.

warnings.credentialsOverNone: Authentication is refused without encryption: the credentials would travel in clear. Choose STARTTLS or TLS, or remove the username for a relay without authentication.

smtp.saved: The SMTP settings have been saved.

test.title: Test email
test.intro: Sends a test email with the saved settings. Save your changes first.

to.label: Recipient address
to.hint: The address that will receive the test email.

test.success: The test email was accepted by the server in {duration} ms.
test.failure: The test email could not be sent.

rateLimited.one: Too many test emails. Try again in {count} second.
rateLimited.other: Too many test emails. Try again in {count} seconds.

dns.title: DNS check (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
dns.intro: Indicative check of the DNS records of the sender address domain. Without them, the emails may be classified as spam.

selectors.label: DKIM selectors
selectors.hint: Selectors cannot be discovered automatically: enter up to 5, separated by commas (for example selector1, selector2 for Microsoft 365).

dns.notConfigured: Save a sender address first to check its domain.

templates.title: Email templates
templates.intro: Customize the emails sent by the entity, for each language. A template that is not customized uses the default text.
templates.caption: Email templates

keyDescription.verification-code: Sent to the sender to verify their address.
keyDescription.transfer-notification: Sent to the recipients with the download link.
keyDescription.transfer-confirmation: Sent to the sender once the transfer is available.
keyDescription.first-download: Sent to the sender at the first download.
keyDescription.file-problems: Sent to the sender when a file is infected or withheld.
keyDescription.file-not-scanned: Sent to the sender when a file could not be scanned.
keyDescription.invitation: Sent to the external person invited to deposit.
keyDescription.quota-warning: Sent to the delegated administrators at 80% of the quota.
keyDescription.quota-reached: Sent to the delegated administrators when the quota is reached.
keyDescription.antivirus-unavailable: Sent when the antivirus stops responding.

editor.title: {template} ({language})

text.hint: Plain text version, read by the mail clients that do not display HTML.

editor.syntax: Variables are written between double braces, for example {example}.

variables.title: Available variables
variables.intro: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor position, in the last field used.
variables.requiredNote: Required variables must appear in the template.

description.validity_minutes: Lifetime of the code, in minutes.
description.inviter_email: Address of the internal user who sends the invitation.
description.message: Message of the sender or of the inviter, quoted; empty when there is none.
description.expiry_date: Date when the unused invitation expires.
description.expiry_datetime: Date and time when the transfer expires.
description.password_notice: Notice that the password comes through another channel; empty without password.
description.qr_code: QR code of the download link (HTML only; empty in the text body).
description.withheld_files: Files withheld because they could not be scanned; empty when there is none.
description.infected_files: Infected files, deleted, with the detected threat; empty when there is none.
description.problem_summary: Short summary for the subject (infected file deleted, or file withheld).
description.outcome: Whether the other files were sent or the whole transfer was rejected.
description.download_datetime: Date and time of the first complete download.
description.deletion_notice: When the transfer will be erased, or that this notice is sent only once.
description.usage_percent: Share used, with the percent sign, rounded down.
description.threshold_percent: Alert threshold, with the percent sign.
description.total_size: Size of the disk of the data directory.

unknown.one: Unknown variable: {names}. It will not be replaced.
unknown.other: Unknown variables: {names}. They will not be replaced.

serverError.title: The template contains errors
serverError.notSaved: The template was not saved: correct the errors listed below.
serverError.note: The error messages of the server are written in English.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subject: Subject: {subject}
preview.note: This preview shows the structure and content of the email without its styles, with images replaced by their description and links disabled. The email received shows them normally.

reset.confirmText: Your customization of this template in this language will be permanently deleted.
reset.done: The default template has been restored.
reset.reloadFailed: The default template has been restored, but it could not be loaded again: {message}
reset.reloaded: The template has been loaded again.

legal.title: Legal information
legal.intro: Texts shown on the legal information page of the entity, in Markdown, for each language.
legal.caption: Legal documents

editor.title: {document} ({language})

markdown.label: Text (Markdown)
markdown.hint: Headings with #, lists with -, links with [text](address) (https: or mailto: addresses only). HTML is not interpreted.

editor.previewEmpty: No preview: the text is empty.
editor.previewNote: Preview of the saved text. Save to update the preview.

emptyConfirm.title: Delete the document?
emptyConfirm.text: The text is empty: saving it deletes this document, which will no longer be shown on the public pages in this language.
